name: unity_component_ops
description: Unity Editor component management: add, remove, get, and modify components on GameObjects via run_unity_python. Use when AI needs to: (1) add components (Rigidbody, Collider, Light, Camera, AudioSource, etc.), (2) remove components, (3) get component property values, (4) set component property values (serialized fields), (5) list all components on a GameObject. NOT for: creating GameObjects (use unity-gameobject-ops), script creation (use unity-editor-control).
